title: Public swimming pool.
content: I don’t swim much irl. I can swim ok but i don’t enjoy water in my ears too much. I will swim if I’m hot so there’s no trauma that i can remember around swimming. Anyone else mall world have a public pool. It’s closed but you CAN use it kinda. There’s always a damn pool. The public bathrooms of terror are present. If it’s indoors. One time the pool was outdoors. You’re facing getting kicked out of the pool. The pool seems clean. As opposed to the bathrooms. Anyone else have poools? In the indoor pool mall there is also an indoor hot tub area a few areas away.
